//go:build wasip3

package main

import "net/http/wasihttp"

// On the fork's GOOS=wasip3 the handlers are the reactor's: a reactor never runs main, so the mux is
// registered from init, and the configuration directory is the preopen the host grants as /config.
func init() {
	configDir = "/config"
	wasihttp.Handle(newMux())
}

func main() {}
